method: Three fixed revisions; fresh process per case/repetition/version; five repetitions, serial old/new/improved then reversed order. Cold then same-Game warm. Runtime creation outside measured request, matching Game lifetime. No concurrent test/browser benchmark. All requested results retained; no Pending silently omitted.
